Definition: a Jerachmeelite or descendant of Jerachmeel
BiblicalUsage: A Jerachmeelite is a descendant of Jerachmeel, named among the men of the south of Judah. In 1 Samuel 27:10, against the south of the Jerahmeelites. The fuller story is told on the Jerahmeel profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that the Jerachmeelite belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
